text.en: 1. This Order is the Casino Control (Exemptions relating to Pre-Paid Entry Levies) Order 2019 .

heading.en: Exemptions from section 116(6) and (6A) of Act

text.en: 3. Section 116(6) and (6A) of the Act does not apply to a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore who enters the casino premises of a casino operator on or after 4 April 2019 without paying a new entry levy, if the citizen or permanent resident has paid before that date to the casino operator a pre-paid entry levy and the validity period of that pre-paid entry levy is current at the time of entry.

4. Section 116(1) of the Act does not apply to a casino operator that allows a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore to enter the casino premises of the casino operator on or after 4 April 2019 without paying a new entry levy, if the citizen or permanent resident is exempt under paragraph 3 from section 116(6) and (6A) of the Act.
